full-scene-effects.name: Full-Scene Effects
full-scene-effects.description: Apply all enabled effects to everything, not just levels and the editor.

pause-menu-button.name: Show in Level Pause Menu
pause-menu-button.description: Show the mod settings button in the level pause menu.

editor-pause-button.name: Show in Editor Pause Menu
editor-pause-button.description: Show the mod settings button in the editor pause menu.

frame-history-capture.name: Frame Generation (Experimental, Android)
frame-history-capture.description: Experimental Android forward-predictive frame generation targeting a 1.5x display cadence: one predicted frame every two real-frame intervals. Requires EGL_ANDROID_presentation_time; if unavailable, generated presentation is disabled rather than risking real-frame pacing. Uses a 16x16 motion field with protected 8x8 refinement, validated motion reuse, and real-pixel fallback for uncertain regions. The real frame is submitted first. When GPU timer queries are supported, generation pauses if measured GPU cost exceeds 4 ms and probes again after a cooldown. It can still reduce performance and does not increase game simulation FPS.

render-scale.name: Render Scale
render-scale.description: Multiplier applied after the selected FSR 1 or SGSR 1 quality preset (100% keeps the preset resolution). Custom uses the slider as the base resolution. Spatial-upscaler input is capped at native resolution.

upscale-method.name: Upscale Method
upscale-method.description: How the game is scaled back up. Turn off automatically at 1x scale.

fsr-sharpness.name: FSR Reconstruction Blend
fsr-sharpness.description: FSR 1: blends bilinear with EASU. FSR Lite: controls edge-guided reconstruction strength and its gradual bilinear fallback.

cas-sharpness.name: CAS Sharpness
cas-sharpness.description: Sharpening strength. 0 has less ringing, 1 is strongest.

bloom-threshold.name: Bloom Threshold
bloom-threshold.description: Brightness cutoff. Higher means only brighter pixels glow.

bloom-intensity.name: Bloom Intensity
bloom-intensity.description: Strength of the glow over the original image.

bloom-radius.name: Bloom Radius
bloom-radius.description: Spread of the glow in pixels at 1080p (scales with resolution).

fsr-quality-preset.name: FSR 1 Quality Preset
fsr-quality-preset.description: Selects the base FSR 1 input resolution. Render Scale is an additional multiplier. Custom uses the Render Scale slider without a preset ratio.

frame-pacing-enabled.name: Frame Pacing (Android)
frame-pacing-enabled.description: Requests EGL swap interval 1 and, when EGL_ANDROID_presentation_time is available, timestamps real frames and places generated frames halfway through the measured app-frame interval. Falls back to normal EGL swap pacing when unsupported; the compositor still controls final presentation.

low-latency-enabled.name: Low Latency (Android)
low-latency-enabled.description: Requests EGL swap interval 0 to avoid the app-side vsync wait where supported. May cause uneven pacing or tearing; it does not change GPU queue depth. Takes precedence over Frame Pacing if both are enabled.

sgsr-operation-mode.name: SGSR 1 Operation Mode
sgsr-operation-mode.description: RGBA uses green-channel luma, RGBY uses a temporary luma-in-alpha conversion while preserving original transparency, and LERP uses linear sampling without edge sharpening.

sgsr-quality-preset.name: SGSR 1 Quality Preset
sgsr-quality-preset.description: Controls SGSR1 input resolution independently from Operation Mode. Custom uses Render Scale without a preset ratio; lower presets reduce capture resolution.
